"""Order-preserving de-duplication supporting unhashable items."""


def stable_unique(items):
    """Return a new list of first occurrences, preserving order.

    Hashable items are tracked in a set for speed; unhashable items
    (lists, dicts, ...) fall back to equality comparison against the
    previously kept unhashable items. Hashable and unhashable items are
    also compared by equality across groups so that, e.g., a custom
    unhashable object equal to a kept hashable one is treated as a
    duplicate. The input is not mutated.
    """
    result = []
    seen_hashable = set()
    for item in items:
        try:
            hash(item)
        except TypeError:
            if any(item == kept for kept in result):
                continue
            result.append(item)
            continue
        if item in seen_hashable:
            continue
        # A hashable item could still equal a previously kept unhashable one.
        if any(item == kept for kept in result if not _is_hashable(kept)):
            continue
        seen_hashable.add(item)
        result.append(item)
    return result


def _is_hashable(value):
    try:
        hash(value)
    except TypeError:
        return False
    return True
